title: PCB verification receipt as a re-runnable ledger
summary: build_receipt now renders in the inline viewer as a docked audit ledger — verdict badge, board-hash fingerprint, DRC counts, and per-part provenance — with a Re-run button (new verify_receipt tool) that re-verifies the live board as Holds / Stale / Violated. Clicking a violation flies the camera to it; sourcing is shown but never gates the verdict.
